title: dugandiodendron portoricense
intro: Dugandiodendron portoricense, commonly known as Guayabito, is a species of plant in the family Lauraceae. It is native to the Andean region and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Dugandiodendron portoricense include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Dugandiodendron portoricense include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as bronchodilation, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
